latency_ms.description: Time spent building the answer, in milliseconds.

is_next_day.title: Is Next Day
is_next_day.description: True for the day after the latest data (a real forecast); False for an earlier day, whose observed departures exist and can be compared.

total_observed_departures.title: Total Observed Departures
total_observed_departures.description: Observed departures of all returned stations and hours; null for the next day.

ForecastResponse.description: Forecast of one day plus the telemetry of the request.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Service status and the dates it can forecast.

hour_start.title: Hour Start
hour_start.description: Start of the hour, local time (Guadalajara).

observed_departures.title: Observed Departures
observed_departures.description: Departures that actually happened, for a past day; null for the next day.

HourForecast.description: Forecast departures of one station in one service hour.

model_uri.description: Where the service loaded the model from.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Full metadata.json of the exported model (version, run, commits, export time); empty if the model was loaded straight from a models:/ URI.

features.title: Features
features.description: Input features of the model, in pipeline order.

service_hours.title: Service Hours
service_hours.description: Hours of the day the service forecasts.

last_forecast_date.title: Last Forecast Date
